statement: When results are ordered by trust, provenance is the PRIMARY sort key and the numeric confidence only the secondary one. A high-confidence `reconstructed` node MUST NOT outrank a low-confidence `authored` one; confidence only breaks ties inside a tier.
note: Verified by execution: sorting on (provenance_rank, -confidence_score) at v0.8.3 yields this order. intent_b (authored, 0.10) leads intent_a (reconstructed, 0.99); intent_c precedes intent_d on confidence within `captured`.
